command: set -euo pipefail; BASE=/workspace/frankgrid10-organ; SRC=/workspace/.frankgrid10-daemon-src; rm -rf "$SRC"; ORIGIN=$(git -C /workspace/clay-global-research-entity remote get-url origin); git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-frankgrid10-sandbox "$ORIGIN" "$SRC"; install -m 0755 "$SRC/research_entity/experiments/chatgpt_frankgrid10/organ_daemon.py" "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py"; rm -rf "$SRC"; echo DAEMON_SOURCE_SHA256=$(sha256sum "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py" | awk '{print $1}'); python3 -m py_compile "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py"; mkdir -p "$BASE/run" "$BASE/logs" "$BASE/ipc/inbox" "$BASE/ipc/processing" "$BASE/ipc/outbox" "$BASE/ipc/receipts" "$BASE/ipc/deadletter"; if [ -f "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid" ]; then OLD=$(cat "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$OLD" ] && kill -0 "$OLD" 2>/dev/null && tr '\0' ' ' <"/proc/$OLD/cmdline" | grep -Fq '/workspace/frankgrid10-organ/code/organ_daemon.py'; then echo ALREADY_RUNNING_PID=$OLD; cat "$BASE/run/heartbeat.json"; exit 0; fi; fi; : > "$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log"; nohup setsid python3 "$BASE/code/organ_daemon.py" --poll 0.5 >>"$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & PID=$!; echo "$PID" > "$BASE/run/organ-daemon.pid"; sleep 2; kill -0 "$PID"; echo PID=$PID; echo CMDLINE=$(tr '\0' ' ' <"/proc/$PID/cmdline"); echo HEARTBEAT; cat "$BASE/run/heartbeat.json"; echo LOG_TAIL; tail -40 "$BASE/logs/organ-daemon.log" || true; echo FRANKGRID10_ORGAN_DAEMON_START_PASS
